hero.headline: Intelligent Electronic Data Capture for Modern Clinical Trials
hero.description: Capture clinical study data with workflows built for visibility and dependable review.

overview.title: Clear at collection.
paragraphs: TruForm™ EDC is a next-generation Electronic Data Capture (EDC) platform engineered to transform the way clinical trial data is collected, managed, and monitored. Designed for sponsors, CROs, biotechnology companies, and research institutions, the platform combines an intuitive user experience with enterprise-grade security, automation, and regulatory compliance to support Phase I-IV clinical studies of any size or complexity.

The platform enables rapid study startup through configurable electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs), metadata-driven study design, reusable libraries, and automated validation rules. Built-in edit checks, query management, medical coding integration, and real-time monitoring help ensure high-quality data from the point of entry through database lock.

TruForm EDC integrates seamlessly with CTMS, RTSM, ePRO, eConsent, laboratory systems, imaging platforms, safety databases, and external data sources, providing a unified ecosystem for clinical trial execution.

By reducing manual data entry, minimizing queries, and improving data quality, TruForm EDC helps organizations shorten study timelines, reduce operational costs, and accelerate regulatory submissions while maintaining compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ICH-GCP, GDPR, HIPAA, and global regulatory standards.

hero.headline: AI-Powered CDISC SDTM Automation Platform
hero.description: Organize study data into consistent standards for clearer downstream use.

overview.title: From source data
paragraphs: Preparing submission-ready SDTM datasets remains one of the most resource-intensive activities in clinical programming. TruForm SDTM transforms this process through intelligent automation, metadata-driven programming, and AI-assisted specification generation.

The platform automatically converts raw clinical trial data from multiple source systems into CDISC SDTM-compliant datasets while maintaining complete traceability throughout the data transformation process.

Using reusable standards libraries, configurable mapping rules, automated validations, and standardized metadata repositories, TruForm SDTM significantly reduces programming effort while improving consistency, quality, and regulatory readiness.
Sponsors can accelerate FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, Health Canada, and other global regulatory submissions while reducing development costs and minimizing programming errors.

Automated derivations, reusable metadata libraries, AI-assisted specifications, and standardized programming frameworks reduce development effort and improve consistency across studies.
Designed for biostatistics and statistical programming teams, TruForm ADaM accelerates study analyses while ensuring compliance with CDISC standards and regulatory expectations.

hero.headline: AI-Driven Statistical Reporting Platform
hero.description: Bring tables, listings and figures into a clearer, more connected reporting workflow.

overview.title: Consistent reporting.
paragraphs: TruForm TLF automates the production of Tables, Listings, and Figures required for Clinical Study Reports (CSR), Integrated Summary of Safety (ISS), Integrated Summary of Efficacy (ISE), and regulatory submissions.

Rather than developing repetitive statistical programs for every study, organizations can leverage standardized templates, reusable reporting libraries, metadata-driven automation, and AI-assisted specifications to generate consistent, high-quality reports in significantly less time.
The platform supports SAS®, R, and hybrid statistical programming environments while producing publication-ready outputs in PDF, Word, RTF, Excel, PowerPoint, and interactive dashboards.
By automating repetitive reporting tasks, statistical programming teams can focus on scientific interpretation rather than report generation.

hero.headline: Enterprise eTMF & Clinical Document Management
hero.description: Bring essential study documents into one more organized review workflow.

overview.title: Essential documents.
paragraphs: Clinical trial documentation is critical to regulatory compliance, inspection readiness, and operational excellence.
TruForm DocuVault provides a centralized Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) platform designed to manage every essential document generated throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.
The platform supports document creation, version control, electronic signatures, configurable workflows, review and approval cycles, quality checks, automated filing, and long-term archiving.
Real-time completeness metrics, inspection readiness dashboards, and AI-assisted document classification enable organizations to maintain a continuously inspection-ready Trial Master File.
Whether supporting sponsors or CROs, TruForm DocuVault improves collaboration while reducing administrative burden and regulatory risk.

hero.headline: Digital Informed Consent Experience
hero.description: Support an informed consent experience that is clear for participants and teams.

overview.title: Clear study information.
paragraphs: TruForm eConsent transforms informed consent into an engaging digital experience designed to improve participant understanding and study compliance.
Participants can review multimedia educational content, interactive videos, study procedures, risks, benefits, and frequently asked questions before securely signing consent forms electronically.
Electronic version control, re-consenting workflows, multilingual support, remote consenting capabilities, and audit trails simplify consent management while improving participant engagement.
By replacing paper-based processes, TruForm eConsent reduces administrative effort, shortens enrollment timelines, and enhances participant satisfaction.

hero.headline: Independent Clinical Event Adjudication
hero.description: Coordinate independent endpoint review with a more transparent process.

overview.title: Independent review.
paragraphs: Clinical endpoint adjudication requires accuracy, consistency, transparency, and independence.
TruForm Adjudication provides a secure platform that enables independent clinical event committees to review, evaluate, and adjudicate suspected endpoint events using configurable workflows.

Automated case routing, blinded review processes, consensus management, electronic documentation, workflow automation, and comprehensive audit trails improve operational efficiency while maintaining regulatory compliance.
The platform reduces adjudication turnaround time while ensuring unbiased endpoint evaluation across global multicenter clinical trials.

hero.headline: AI-Driven Risk-Based Quality Management
hero.description: Focus quality oversight on the signals and risks that matter most.

overview.title: Meaningful signals.
paragraphs: Modern clinical trials generate enormous volumes of operational and clinical data.
TruForm RBQM continuously analyzes this information using advanced analytics and artificial intelligence to identify potential study risks before they become critical issues.

The platform evaluates Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), protocol deviations, enrollment trends, monitoring activities, data quality metrics, and site performance to deliver actionable insights through real-time dashboards.
Sponsors can proactively manage quality, optimize monitoring resources, reduce operational risk, improve patient safety, and comply with ICH E6(R3) Risk-Based Quality Management guidelines.

Advanced algorithms optimize drug supply distribution across participating sites, reducing medication waste while ensuring uninterrupted product availability.
Flexible randomization methods, adaptive trial support, inventory forecasting, and seamless integration with EDC and CTMS platforms improve operational efficiency while preserving study integrity.
